narrative.overview: A quiet, near-monochrome newsroom whose only colour is the photography. One Drupal theme and one main.css serve eight sites; a brand changes only its header mark, typeface, vehicle menu and favicon.
keyCharacteristics: Ink (#0c121c) on white for all type and UI; dark charcoal footer (#1e1e1e).
Uppercase tracked labels and card titles; 30px sentence-case headings.
Square controls, 4px radius on imagery, circles on icon buttons only.
One soft shadow under the sticky nav.
Download, cart and share on every content unit.

rules.name: The Photography Carries Colour Rule
rules.body: No UI element is coloured; hue on a page comes from the press images and the brand logos.

dos: Do keep every UI element in ink, white and the neutral greys.
Do swap only the typeface, header mark, vehicle menu and favicon per brand; keep the scale identical.
Do set card titles and labels uppercase with 1–1.5px tracking.
Do give every asset its download / share / cart affordances.
donts: Don't add shadows beyond the sticky-nav lift.
Don't introduce gradients other than the video-poster radial.
